LanguageData.PS_MsgBaked: Baked - ManualBalance.json now holds {0} default override(s).
LanguageData.PS_MsgNoImportFiles: No balance-edit JSON files found. Drop a shared file (exported with the Share button) into: {0}
LanguageData.PS_MsgNoShare: No balance edits to share yet - tune some numbers in the Balance editor first.
LanguageData.PS_MsgSynRebuilt: Synergy graph rebuilt from currently-installed psycasts.
LanguageData.PS_Ovr_MedAwaken: Пробуждение от медитации отключено — прорывы по-прежнему дают уровни псионика
LanguageData.PS_SetAltarDaily: Daily meditation cap: {0}h / day (0 = no cap)
LanguageData.PS_SetAltarDailyTip: Caps the pilgrim's meditation per day, forcing the pilgrimage to span real elapsed time. Pilgrimage meditation is exempt from coma risk, so a higher cap simply finishes the quest sooner.
LanguageData.PS_SetAltarTotal: Total meditation required: {0}h (~{1} days at the cap)
LanguageData.PS_SetAltarTotalTip: Hours of meditation the pilgrim must complete at the altar site to advance a tier.
LanguageData.PS_SetAnimaT2Tip: Number of anima-tree sites the Tier II journey visits.
LanguageData.PS_SetAnimaT3Tip: Number of sites the Tier III journey visits; the final one grows the giant ancient anima tree.
LanguageData.PS_SetAutoStats: Auto psycaster stats (no manual upgrades; cost unaffected)
LanguageData.PS_SetAutoStatsTip: When on, VPE's neural-heat limit, neural-heat recovery and psychic sensitivity grow AUTOMATICALLY with each psycaster level, you no longer spend points on them, and the psyfocus cost is left unaffected by leveling. Your points stay free for raising skill levels (this mod's own system); the 'Upgrade Psycaster Stats' button is replaced with a note.
LanguageData.PS_SetBakeBody: Write your {0} edit(s) into ManualBalance.json as the mod's new default balance, then clear the live overlay? (A Workshop update can overwrite the baked file - re-bake afterwards if needed.)
LanguageData.PS_SetBalanceInfo: Edits made in the in-game Balance editor (psycast tab, dev mode) are stored in this config and apply on top of the mod's defaults. The mod is in open beta: if you have balancing ideas, tune the numbers in the editor and use the share button below to export them as a JSON file, grouped per psycast tree and addon tree, then send that file to the author.
LanguageData.PS_SetBreakChanceTip: Проверяется раз в час для медитирующего псионика, еще не достигшего статуса «Озаренный». Непрерывная многочасовая медитация увеличивает этот шанс. Установите 0, чтобы прорывы не происходили вовсе.
LanguageData.PS_SetBreakSizeTip: How much psycaster XP one breakthrough grants. 1.0 is exactly a full level.
LanguageData.PS_SetCastXp: Casting XP per skill tier: {0} (tier-3 cast = {1} XP)
LanguageData.PS_SetCastXpTip: Casting is the main XP source. Each cast grants this much XP per the skill's tier, so deeper psycasts level you faster.
LanguageData.PS_SetChooseLaterInfo: A card pick can always be set aside with its "Choose later" button. The choice is never lost: the cards return while the colonist meditates, and the "Psycast path awaits" alert reopens them with one click.
LanguageData.PS_SetComaRisk: Риск комы за каждый лишний час: {0}%
LanguageData.PS_SetComaRiskTip: Вероятность впасть в кому за каждый час медитации сверх безопасного окна.
LanguageData.PS_SetCostPerLevel: Cost increase per level: +{0}% heat and psyfocus
LanguageData.PS_SetCostPerLevelTip: How steeply a skill's cost rises for each invested level.
LanguageData.PS_SetDisableSynergiesTip: Turn off the whole cross-ability synergy system. Each psycast still grows with its OWN invested levels, but leveling other psycasts of the same path no longer feeds it, and the skill card and hover no longer show "gains power from" or "empowers" links. Off by default.
LanguageData.PS_SetDiscardBody: Discard all {0} of your balance edit(s) and return to the baked defaults?
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyAscensionTip: Off by default. Gives elite Tier III enemy psycasters a full Apotheosis constellation's power, a serious endgame threat.
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyFreqTip: The chance that any given hostile psycaster rolls an Enlightenment tier.
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyT3Tip: Permit Tier III (Illuminated) hostile psycasters, the strongest.
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyTiersTip: Позволяет сильным рейдерам и боссам появляться со случайными ступенями и прокачанными способностями.
LanguageData.PS_SetFalloffTip: Anti-farming. Meditating past the safe window builds saturation that makes a psycaster's breakthroughs rarer. Higher rarefies faster; 0 disables the falloff.
LanguageData.PS_SetFogOfWarTip: Hide the identity of every psycast you have not learned yet behind a "?" on the tree, so you discover each skill only when you unlock it. The tree layout stays visible; click a hidden node to learn it and reveal it. Off by default.
LanguageData.PS_SetForgoPointsTip: At a Transcendent tier-up you may forgo the free psycast-path card for this many bonus specialization points instead (on top of the tier's own +3).
LanguageData.PS_SetGuarantee: Awakening guaranteed after: {0} cumulative meditation hours
LanguageData.PS_SetGuaranteeTip: A non-psycaster's odds of Awakening to Tier I ramp with total meditation and are GUARANTEED once they reach this many cumulative hours. Around 36 is about a week of dedicated 6-hour days.
LanguageData.PS_SetH_Altar: Trial of the Altar (combat, single site)
LanguageData.PS_SetImportBody: Imported {0} balance edit(s) from {1} into your live overlay. They apply on top of the mod's defaults and can be shared, discarded, or (in dev mode) baked like any other edit.
LanguageData.PS_SetIsekaiTip: When ISEKAI RPG Leveling is installed, stop it from raising psychic sensitivity, neural heat limit and recovery, meditation focus and psyfocus, so this mod's own scaling stays authoritative. Takes effect on restart.
LanguageData.PS_SetLevelCapTip: Set Vanilla Psycasts Expanded's maximum psycaster level to the value below. Enlightenment tiers do not affect this cap. Off leaves VPE's own setting untouched.
LanguageData.PS_SetLevelCapValTip: The flat psycaster level ceiling. Default 400.
LanguageData.PS_SetLinksTip: Способности в одном древе связаны. Прокачка одной немного усиливает те, что она подпитывает, а на карточке навыка показано, какие именно.
LanguageData.PS_SetLockPathsTip: Paths unlock ONLY through the awakening cards; the tab's normal Unlock buttons are disabled. Dev mode still bypasses this.
LanguageData.PS_SetMaxSkillLevelTip: Жесткий предел уровня для любой отдельной способности. Специализация Конвергенция поднимает его еще на +5.
LanguageData.PS_SetMechTreesTip: Re-enable the Mechanitor Mech-Mind paths the addon ships but locks away as removed content.
LanguageData.PS_SetMedBars: Отображать индикаторы риска комы и опыта
LanguageData.PS_SetMedBarsTip: Показывать компактные шкалы риска комы, опыта и паломничества во вкладке псионики.
LanguageData.PS_SetMedXp: Meditation psycast XP: {0}% of VPE's rate
LanguageData.PS_SetMedXpTip: Meditation also trickles psycast XP, scaled to this fraction of VPE's normal rate. A steady background source rather than the main one.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoDecayTip: On (default): psyfocus never drains on its own. It only rises from meditation and falls when you spend it casting. Off: vanilla decay, where idle psyfocus slowly bleeds away and must be topped up.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoGeneReqTip: Paths that require a specific gene, such as Archon, unlock without needing the gene.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoSkillResetTip: Hide the "Reset skills" button on the psycast tab, so invested skill levels can never be refunded. For hardcore or no-take-backs runs. Off by default.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoSpecResetTip: Hide the "Reset specializations" refund button in the constellation window, so committed specialization points can never be reclaimed. For hardcore or no-take-backs runs. Off by default.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoStartAwakenedTip: On (default): the colonists you begin the game with are exempt from the random Awakened+ roll, so everyone starts the journey with an ordinary, mundane mind and must earn their Awakening. Off: starting colonists roll the same chance as everyone else.
LanguageData.PS_SetOverrideNote: ⚠ {0} переопределено настройкой: {1}. Эта строка не действует.
LanguageData.PS_SetPerLevel: Бонус за вложенный уровень: +{0}% к силе / радиусу / длительности
LanguageData.PS_SetPerLevelTip: Насколько каждое очко, вложенное в способность, повышает ее основную характеристику, радиус и длительность.
LanguageData.PS_SetPerfCacheTip: Caches synergy and skill math for the current tick and frame, so repeated lookups from ability icons, gizmos, tooltips and AI checks cost almost nothing. Values still refresh instantly when anything changes. Leave this on; turn it off only when hunting a suspected display glitch, which makes every value recompute from scratch on every call.
LanguageData.PS_SetPsyLevelsPerSkill: Требуется уровней псионика на каждый уровень способности: {0}
LanguageData.PS_SetPsyLevelsPerSkillTip: Ограничение: способность можно прокачать только до предела, поддерживаемого общим уровнем псионика.
LanguageData.PS_SetRevealAll: Turn all cards one at a time and re-pick
LanguageData.PS_SetRevealAllTip: On: after turning the first card, the rest of the deal stays face-down and each card is turned BY HAND, one at a time (center it, then click). Any revealed card can be clicked to re-pick before embracing. Off (default): only the card you turn is revealed, and that path is committed.
LanguageData.PS_SetSafeWindow: Безопасное окно медитации в день: {0} ч
LanguageData.PS_SetSafeWindowTip: Количество часов медитации в сутки без риска комы. Превышение этого лимита начинает накапливать риск психической комы.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleBuffTip: Scale the severity of hediffs a cast applies, both boons and debuffs, with level and synergies.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleCost: Higher levels cost more (heat and psyfocus)
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleCostTip: Each invested level also raises the skill's psyfocus cost and neural heat. Scales with the skill's OWN level only; synergies never add cost.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleDurationTip: Scale an ability's effect duration with its level and synergies, for longer buffs and debuffs.
LanguageData.PS_SetScalePowerTip: Scale an ability's power, such as melee and explosion damage, with its level and synergies.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleRadiusTip: Scale an ability's area-of-effect radius with its level and synergies.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleSensTip: Briefly raise the caster's psychic sensitivity during a cast so addon effects hardcoded as a multiple of sensitivity, such as Geomancer's, also scale.
LanguageData.PS_SetSkillFxTip: Воспроизводить визуальные вспышки и звуки при прокачке способностей.
LanguageData.PS_SetSpecLevelsTip: How many psycaster levels grant one point to spend on the constellation tree. Lower means points flow faster.
LanguageData.PS_SetSpecXpTip: Casting also earns specialization points. This is the XP needed per point; lower makes the Apotheosis tree reachable sooner.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynDisabledNote: The synergy and empower system is currently disabled (Skills tab). These settings still edit the stored graph, but it has no effect in-game until you re-enable synergies.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynFrozen: Synergies are frozen the first time they are generated and never change afterward, even if you add psycast addons later.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynRebuild: Rebuild synergy graph from installed psycasts
LanguageData.PS_SetSynRetune: To retune skill effects, synergies and empowers, enable dev mode and open the Balance editor from the psycast tab.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynergyPct: Бонус синергии за уровень способностей того же пути: +{0}%
LanguageData.PS_SetSynergyPctTip: Прокачка других способностей того же пути усиливает эту способность через направленные синергии.
LanguageData.PS_SetT3Throne: Tier III always uses the grand throne.
LanguageData.PS_SetTransBase: First Transcendent tier after: {0} meditation hours
LanguageData.PS_SetTransBaseTip: Cumulative post-Illuminated meditation hours to reach Tier IV. Higher makes the endless climb slower.
LanguageData.PS_SetTransCurve: Transcendent breakthrough curve: x{0} per tier
LanguageData.PS_SetTransCurveTip: Above Illuminated, each Transcendent tier multiplies a psycaster's hourly breakthrough chance by +this, so deep Transcendents earn free levels faster as leveling slows. The chance stays hard-capped at 60% - it never becomes guaranteed.
LanguageData.PS_SetTransGrowthTip: Each Transcendent tier costs this multiple of the previous tier's meditation (geometric diminishing returns). At x1.6, Tier V costs 1.6x Tier IV, Tier VI 2.56x, and so on.
LanguageData.PS_SetTranscendTip: On: an Illuminated (Tier III) psycaster who keeps meditating climbs into open-ended Transcendent tiers (IV, V, ...). Each tier grants bonus specialization points and an animated psycast-card pick for a free path. Off: Illuminated is the ceiling.
LanguageData.PS_SetWaveScaleTip: Multiplier on each wave's combat strength. Higher makes the waves deadlier.
